subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Consider the following statements 
 
(a) If S1 & S2 are linear and time invariant, then 
interchanging their order does not change the 
system. 
 
(b) If S1 & S2 are linear and time varying, then 
interchanging their order does not change the 
system. 
 
True statements are 
 
 (a) Both a & b 
 
(b) Only a 
 
 
(c) Only b 
 
(d) None of these
